title: docs.note.created.v1
description: A study note was created, or an edit added the tag `issue` to it (then `createdAt` is still the note's creation time). Study notes are private: neither the note's body nor the text it quotes is ever carried, only its tags. A subscriber that needs more asks Docs for it.

docPath.description: The document's path in the source repository

tags.description: The note's #word tags, lower-cased, in the order first seen

hasIssue.description: True when the note already has a GitHub issue
